ابتهجا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَهَجَا (ibtahajā) /ib.ta.ha.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# اُبْتُهِجَا (ubtuhijā) /ub.tu.hi.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# اِبْتَهِجَا (ibtahijā) /ib.ta.hi.d͡ʒaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
